intro: Belarusian culture includes folk festivals, castles and celebrated artists and writers.

chapters.title: Castles and festivals
text: The castles of Mir and Nesvizh are World Heritage Sites. Kupalle, the midsummer festival, involves bonfires, wreaths and a search for a magical fern flower.

chapters.title: Artists
text: Marc Chagall's dreamy paintings of floating figures were inspired by his childhood in Vitebsk, which now hosts a large arts festival every summer.

keyTerms.meaning: A midsummer festival celebrated in Belarus and neighbouring countries.
